how_to_fix: Pass at least two Wire or endpoint Vertex sections.
Keep Wire topology compatible across sections.
If loft fails, inspect each section individually and simplify its geometry.
possible_causes: Fewer than two sections were provided.
A Vertex section was used away from the start or end.
One or more Wire/Vertex sections are invalid or incompatible.
The kernel rejected the loft because the section geometry is inconsistent.
bad_policy.technical_details: ValueError: 'bogus' is not a valid TrackingPolicy
bad_policy.what_happened: Failed to loft the input profiles into a solid.

how_to_fix: Check every station against its Inventory row (edges / closure / centroid).
possible_causes: Two adjacent sections sit at the same location (no generation direction to skin across).
Edge counts differ too much across stations for the kernel to establish point correspondence.
A section is open, or the list order disagrees with the generation direction.
repair: S1 and S2 sit at the same location: a loft needs its sections distributed along the generation direction — remove the duplicate section or fix the station placements
coincident.technical_details: kernel reported: loft build did not complete; section count=2
coincident.what_happened: the loft_rsolid kernel build did not complete; the section compatibility check found: S2 coincides with S1 (centroid distance 0 mm)
